sources.scope: Bounded Qwen3.5/Qwen3-Next caller, GDN phase/architecture policy, separate conv wrappers and state metadata; no native execution or external kernel equivalence.

applicability: Separate causal-conv phase/layout/state contracts and conditional one-shot classification-prefill transfer
limitations: Native kernels, models and devices not_run
No HF binding, sm89/backend qualification, numerical/model-quality or performance claim
Whole reset/cancellation/radix eviction, speculative and ReplaySSM lifecycles outside this readset
attribution: SGLang and Qwen contributors; Apache-2.0 root license. Conv files retain vLLM adaptation and Tri Dao notices. Caller contracts only; no external kernel implementation imported.

findings.direction: Resolve prefill recurrence and decode convolution separately
findings.reason: On the pinned path, the CUDA GDN prefill convolution alias can be rebound while ordinary decode keeps the Triton conv-update alias. A FlashInfer prefill setting or a CUDA update symbol does not show that decode was dispatched there.
findings.revisit_when: Trace runner-level overrides and effective aliases through the owning backend. Check the SM9/FP32 and SM10/BF16/CUDA13 prefill predicates before asking for an execution trace.

findings.direction: Use the actual last-axis stride and sequence lengths to classify convolution prefill
findings.reason: Even a CUDA input can take Triton when last_stride != 1 and seq_lens_cpu is supplied. That path returns a distinct output while updating state; the CUDA branch returns the modified input buffer it uses.
findings.revisit_when: Inspect strides, packed token offsets and row IDs. Verify the prefix-history mask for convolution independently of recurrent state initialization.

findings.direction: Preserve both state write-backs through a reorder and noncontiguous gather
findings.reason: Ordinary non-CPU extend maps requests to persistent Mamba rows. With noncontiguous pools it gathers indexed copies and scatters both convolution history and the GDN matrix back. A correct immediate output does not exercise their later use.
findings.revisit_when: Check fresh and continued requests after a reorder and compare both state tensors at their mapped rows. Account for separate dtypes and head sharding.

findings.direction: Prove HF classifier parity before transferring an SGLang prefill path
findings.reason: A fresh whole-sequence classifier can use prefill reasoning only after identifying its worker and state contract. MIS additionally assumes delimiter-driven query/item branches, zero cached prefixes, Triton and a compatible layout.
findings.revisit_when: Pin the HF caller and check layout, gates, zero state, mutation behavior, output/state parity and classifier quality before timed comparison.
